name: Connor Wade
summary: Connor Wade runs Evolve Longevity, a longevity/hyperbaric-chamber business. He reached out on 2026-10-06 because his business Instagram, @evolve.longevity, was suspended under Meta's account-integrity Community Standards. Before reaching out he had already uploaded his ID, and Instagram logged that as an appeal on Oct 6, 2026, which could lead to a permanent ban. The case is open: the owner said his reps would give a backend update within about an hour, and no price has been discussed yet.
key_facts: Suspended for violating Community Standards on account integrity; the appeal deadline in Instagram's email is April 4, 2027
Uploaded ID before contacting us, which Instagram recorded as an appeal submitted Oct 6, 2026; the owner warned this may have made the ban permanent

Possible causes: a recent hyperbaric chamber post that got a warning for using someone else's likeness (mentioned the Bryan Johnson protocol), a hired person who DMs about 30 leads/day to set appointments, or a report from a competitor
Has ManyChat but says he doesn't use it
A screenshot shows someone named 'Dre' told him the suspension was 'new IG AI protocols' and would be lifted after verification. The owner said this was wrong
No pricing agreed yet; waiting on the owner's reps for a backend update
services_discussed: Meta Community Standards (account integrity) violation fix
